title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the specialized study zones, simulation labs, and student-focused corners across the East and West campuses that define the daily experience for health sciences students.

cards.title: The Quiet Side of the Library
cards.subtitle: Bryan East Campus Library
cards.notes: Head to this designated zone for individual, intentional study. It is strictly separated from the social computer lab to ensure a distraction-free environment for focused work.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated silent study area within the campus library for individual academic focus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library's physical space is clearly divided for intended uses: The 'Quiet Side' of the Library is designated for individual, quiet, intentional study.
cards.source_title: Library Policies | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 8:00 am to 4:30 pm during summer sessions.

cards.title: Blue Healer Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student Success Center
cards.notes: Visit this student-centric hub for snacks, peer support, and community building. It serves as a primary gathering spot for tutoring services and collaborative learning.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge providing snacks, tutoring, and community support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Blue Healer Lounge & Tutoring Services. Snacks, student support, tutoring & community.
cards.source_title: Academic Services - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Check the Academic Success Center for specific tutoring and lounge hours.

cards.title: Simulation Debriefing Rooms
cards.subtitle: Simulation Center
cards.notes: Utilize these four specialized rooms to reflect on clinical performance. These spaces are essential for reviewing simulation scenarios with faculty and peers.
cards.short_summary: Specialized rooms for reflecting on and reviewing clinical simulation experiences.
cards.evidence_claim: The space offers eight simulation rooms, four control rooms, and four debriefing rooms.
cards.source_title: Campus Facilities | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Access is typically integrated into clinical lab schedules and simulation sessions.

cards.title: The Testing Center Study Space
cards.subtitle: Bryan East Campus
cards.notes: When not hosting accommodated exams, this quiet facility is open to all students for small group study sessions. It is a reliable alternative to the main library.
cards.short_summary: A testing facility that doubles as a small group study space when exams are not in session.
cards.evidence_claim: When not in use for testing, the space is available to students for small group study.
cards.source_title: Campus Facilities | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on the scheduled testing calendar; check with the Coordinator.

cards.title: West Campus Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Bryan West Medical Center
cards.notes: Located near the Natural Science Laboratories, this lounge provides a convenient break spot for students attending cadaver labs or science lectures at the West site.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student lounge area located at the Bryan West Campus satellite site.
cards.evidence_claim: This location is home to the College's three Natural Science Laboratories... and a student lounge area.
cards.source_title: Campus Facilities | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Located at 2300 S. 16th St. within the medical center complex.

cards.title: Library Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Bryan East Campus Library
cards.notes: This is the social side of the library. Use the college computers here for group work, or take advantage of the casual seating for community events and socializing.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative computer lab and social space within the campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Computer Lab is a space for individual and group use of the College computers, and has casual seating for group work, socializing and community events.
cards.source_title: Library Policies | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; casual seating is available for group interaction.

cards.title: Skills Laboratories
cards.subtitle: Bryan East Campus
cards.notes: Practice your clinical techniques using real healthcare equipment. These labs are accessible for students to refine psychomotor skills outside of formal class time.
cards.short_summary: Hands-on laboratories where students practice clinical and healthcare skills.
cards.evidence_claim: The skills and simulation laboratories are easily accessible for student use. Students utilize the facilities in the laboratories to learn, practice and...
cards.source_title: Simulation and Skills Laboratories | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Students can borrow items like stethoscopes for 24 hours from the library for use here.

cards.title: The Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Student Success Center
cards.notes: Get expert help with APA or AMA style formatting for your research papers. This specialized service is a key resource for mastering professional healthcare documentation.
cards.short_summary: A support center helping students with academic writing and healthcare citation styles.
cards.evidence_claim: Get support with APA or AMA style... Writing Center.
cards.source_title: Students Landing Page - Bryan College of Health Sciences Library
cards.access_notes: Appointments can be scheduled through the Student Success Center.

cards.title: Plastinate and Cadaver Lab
cards.subtitle: Bryan West Campus
cards.notes: Study human anatomy using rare plastinated specimens. This advanced lab at the West site offers a unique, hands-on look at the human body for biomedical students.
cards.short_summary: An anatomy laboratory featuring plastinated human specimens and cadaver study.
cards.evidence_claim: The West site houses one of the college's two plastinated human body specimens, and is the location for all human cadaver labs.
cards.source_title: Campus Facilities | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Restricted access; primarily used for Natural Science instruction and labs.

cards.title: Library Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Bryan East Campus Library
cards.notes: Reserve this private room for collaborative projects. It is the only enclosed group space on the 'Quiet Side,' making it ideal for focused team discussions.
cards.short_summary: A reservable private room for group collaboration within the library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Group Study Room (on the 'Quiet Side') may be reserved for group use.
cards.source_title: Library Policies | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Reservations can be made using the library's online booking tool.
